reason: Nothing beats freshly ground mixer chutney made at home, and paying ₹99 for a 100g tube from an unknown brand makes zero financial sense.
objection: Packaged chutney cannot match fresh homemade taste, and at ₹99 for just 100g it is way too costly.
would_change_my_mind: If it tastes exactly like home-ground chutney and costs under ₹40 per tube.
